text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"multiple connected paragraphs with a clear position","quality":"coherence","description":"This captures the ability to organize ideas into a readable sequence that develops a response rather than presenting isolated fragments."},{"evidence":"full sentences with punctuation and transitions like 'Also,' 'So,' and 'In addition,'","quality":"sentential control","description":"This captures producing complete, linked sentences that show control over sentence boundaries and flow."},{"evidence":"extended argument about self-esteem and achievement","quality":"development","description":"This captures elaborating an idea with reasons, examples, and explanation instead of only brief statements."},{"evidence":"attempts such as 'self-esteem,' 'self confident,' and 'achievement' used repeatedly in context","quality":"lexical range","description":"This captures having enough vocabulary to express the topic with some variety and repeated topic-specific terms."},{"evidence":"errors like 'they're self confident' and 'their selves' but meaning stays clear","quality":"meaning clarity","description":"This captures writing that, despite grammatical mistakes, remains understandable to the reader across most of the essay."}]}
